Description: A microplate absorbance or fluorescence reader used to detect and quantify ELISA signal, typically measuring optical density at a defined wavelength across 96- or 384-well plate formats.

A liquid chromatography mass spectrometry system equipped with a quadrupole time-of-flight (Q-TOF) mass analyzer, used for high-resolution, accurate-mass detection of peptides, proteins, or small molecules. Preferred for untargeted or discovery workflows where unknown compound identification is required.

A liquid chromatography mass spectrometry system equipped with a triple quadrupole (QqQ) mass analyzer, used for targeted quantification of specific analytes via selected reaction monitoring (SRM) or multiple reaction monitoring (MRM). Preferred for large-panel targeted quantification requiring high sensitivity and wide dynamic range.

The Luminex FLEXMAP 3D instrument; a flow-based, high-throughput bead-based multiplex immunoassay reader compatible with both 96- and 384-well plates, capable of measuring up to 500 analytes per well using xMAP technology with three laser excitation.

The Luminex MAGPIX instrument; a compact, imaging-based bead-based multiplex immunoassay reader using magnetic bead capture and LED/CCD-based detection, supporting up to 50 analytes per well in a 96-well plate format.

The Meso Scale Discovery (MSD) MESO QuickPlex SQ 120 instrument; a compact electrochemiluminescence (ECL)-based immunoassay reader using proprietary MULTI-ARRAY plate technology, supporting up to 10 analytes per well with limits of detection as low as 0.05 to 1 pg/mL.

The Meso Scale Discovery (MSD) MESO SECTOR S 600 instrument; a high-throughput ECL-based immunoassay reader supporting up to 50 plates per hour, compatible with 96- and 384-well formats, with sensitivity as low as 0.05 pg/mL and multiplex capability of up to 10 analytes per well.
A proximity ligation-based immunoassay platform developed by Alamar Biosciences for simultaneous measurement of 120 CNS disease-relevant protein biomarkers from low-volume samples
A proximity ligation-based immunoassay platform developed by Alamar Biosciences for simultaneous measurement of 120 mouse protein targets from low-volume samples
Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer contains three mass analyzers: a quadrupole analyzer, an Orbitrap analyzer, and the Astral analyzer.

The Quanterix HD-X Analyzer; a fully automated single-molecule array (Simoa) instrument that isolates individual immunocomplexes on paramagnetic beads in femtoliter-sized microwells for digital detection, enabling ultrasensitive protein quantification up to 1,000-fold more sensitive than conventional ELISA.

The Quanterix SP-X Imaging and Analysis System; a compact benchtop Simoa instrument using planar array technology for simultaneous ultrasensitive quantification of up to 10 protein biomarkers per well, combining Simoa sensitivity with multiplexing flexibility.
Bruker timsTOF Pro trapped ion mobility spectrometry quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometer, enabling high-sensitivity proteomics with ion mobility separation

A 10x Genomics transcriptomics method that uses a spatially barcoded slide to capture and detect mRNA in intact tissue sections where sample placement on the slide is a manual process. There is a total of 4992 spots in each capture area measuring 6.5mm x 6.5mm.

Visium HD Spatial Gene Expression is a probe-based whole-transcriptome spatial gene expression assay that captures mRNA at single-cell-scale resolution using continuous 2 µm capture features (~11 million features across a 6.5 by 6.5 mm capture area) compatible with formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) freshly frozen and fixed frozen tissue sections.

A spatial molecular profiling assay that maps the expression of targeted RNA panels within intact tissue sections at single-cell and subcellular resolution. This assay can identify the location of target transcripts within the tissue providing a single cell resolution map of expression patterns of all genes that are included in the selected probe panel and generating a single-cell-resolution expression map of all profiled genes.
